categories.main_business_segments: Ziel Home Furnishing Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of self-owned brand furniture and home products. Its product portfolio includes furniture series, home series, pet series, and sports & outdoor products. The company operates mainly in the online retail sector, focusing on B2C and B2B sales channels across global markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovative product design and technology, notably its proprietary TOOLLESS assembly technology that enables tool-free furniture installation, enhancing user convenience and reducing material usage. It employs standardized product development processes, modular design, and digital supply chain management systems to improve efficiency and product quality. Manufacturing is outsourced to external suppliers, with the company focusing on R&D and brand operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ziel serves end consumers primarily through online retail platforms such as Amazon, OTTO, TEMU, SHEIN, and independent websites, targeting households in Europe, North America, Japan, and emerging markets. Key customers include individual consumers (B2C) and business clients (B2B) such as large retail chains and supermarkets. The company has a strong presence in the furniture and home goods categories.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a focus on over 70 countries and regions, including Europe (Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK), North America (USA, Canada, Mexico), Japan, Australia, and emerging markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. It maintains subsidiaries and warehouses in key markets to support localized operations and logistics.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ziel operates primarily in the downstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on product design, brand management, and online retail sales. Manufacturing is outsourced to external suppliers, while the company manages global supply chain coordination, logistics, and distribution through a hybrid warehouse network combining self-operated, platform, and third-party warehouses.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes product innovation with increased R&D investment, focusing on design, packaging, materials, and assembly technologies. It aims to expand product categories and enhance user experience through modular and standardized designs. Strategic initiatives include global supply chain diversification (China+N model), digital transformation with AI integration, and strengthening local market operations and compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct product sales via online retail platforms (B2C) and wholesale to business clients (B2B). The company leverages multiple e-commerce channels, including Amazon Vendor and independent websites, and also earns income from logistics and warehousing services. Investment income from financial products contributes marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ziel is positioned as a leading global internet home furnishing brand with strong market share in Europe and North America, particularly on Amazon's European marketplaces where it ranks first in home furniture categories. It competes with other global online furniture retailers and emerging cross-border e-commerce platforms, leveraging its brand recognition, product innovation, and supply chain efficiency to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 8.12 billion, representing a 33.74% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 333.57 million, a 19.21% decrease from the previous year. The company has shown strong revenue growth driven by product innovation and channel expansion, with total assets exceeding RMB 6.27 billion and equity of RMB 3.23 billion at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ziel emphasizes delivering stylish, affordable, and easy-to-assemble furniture solutions that meet consumers' full home furnishing needs. Its TOOLLESS assembly technology differentiates products by simplifying installation and reducing packaging waste. The company offers a comprehensive product matrix with standardized components, enabling efficient production and consistent quality. Its global logistics network and localized operations enhance customer experience and market responsiveness.
